interviewSteps.title: Household
interviewSteps.copy: Start with the people, filing setup, and plan timeline. The app uses this to calculate ages, tax filing, RMD timing, Social Security, and Medicare logic.

interviewSteps.title: Assumptions
interviewSteps.copy: These are plain-English defaults for growth, inflation, taxes, and account draw order. Strategy Builder can override most of them for specific years.

interviewSteps.title: Opening Year
interviewSteps.copy: Enter the account balances and spending base at the start of the first plan year. Use zero or blank only for accounts that do not exist.

interviewSteps.title: Inherited IRAs
interviewSteps.copy: Use this only when inherited retirement accounts exist. The setup needs rule details, not just balances, so the model can calculate required withdrawals correctly.

interviewSteps.title: Income
interviewSteps.copy: Work income and Social Security are separate. Fill in only the sections that apply; retired users can skip work income and focus on Social Security.

interviewSteps.title: 401k Defaults
interviewSteps.copy: Set global employee and employer 401k contribution percentages once. Annual Check-In or Start of Year can override a specific year when reality changes.

interviewSteps.title: Medicare & IRMAA
interviewSteps.copy: This section estimates Medicare surcharges and sets guardrails for Roth conversions. It is optional, but important when Medicare income thresholds matter.

interviewSteps.title: Review
interviewSteps.copy: Check what is complete, what is assumed, and where the plan may need attention before generating a report.
